approach: Engine reimplementation in Rust on Bevy: reads the game data the player extracts from their own install, no original client code run, offline
notes: 0.8: single-player runs on the Crypt and the Gothic Castle with all eight classes, their skills, the monsters' behaviour trees and the bosses, loot, the stash and the merchant, plus a Test Arena. Game files are not included: the data comes from your own install (see EXTRACTION.md).
